description: The Cursor Origin public API client behind forge_origin.OriginAdapter (FORGE-PORT, CANALE8).

origin-client.auth_token_env.description: Environment variable the origin CLI prefers for its credential (a token exchanged from the key). A name only: the preflight checks that it (or origin-client.credential_env) is set and never reads or prints the value (ORIGIN-FINISH R3).

origin-client.cli.description: The Origin CLI that carries this client's calls. It is the transport because the API refuses a crsr_ key as a Bearer token (HTTP 401) and the spec documents no key-exchange operation, so the exchange exists only inside the CLI.
origin-client.cli.x-source: FORGE-PORT (CANALE8); measured 401 on a Bearer call, no exchange operation in the spec

origin-client.cli_dirs.description: Directories searched for the Origin CLI when it is neither pinned by origin-client.cli_env nor on PATH, a leading ~ being the user's home. A cloud session installs it in ~/.local/bin, which a fresh lane shell did not always have on PATH (8 bootstrap calls a lane, F81).

origin-client.cli_env.description: Environment variable that pins the Origin CLI's path when it is not on PATH (a test, a pinned install). Absent, the CLI is found on PATH by origin-client.cli.

origin-client.credential_env.description: Environment variable the origin CLI reads its Cursor API key from. A name only: the preflight checks that it (or origin-client.auth_token_env) is set and never reads or prints the value (ORIGIN-FINISH R3).

origin-client.git_hosts.description: The git hosts that serve Origin repositories; the Origin adapter refuses a git remote on any other host, so merges and locks never reach another forge.

origin-client.max_pages.description: Pages one paged read follows before it refuses rather than returning a silently truncated list.

origin-client.merge_methods.description: The mergeMethod values the spec's MergePullRequestRequest accepts.

origin-client.message_max_chars.description: Characters of the API's own error message an error keeps; the sentence that names the failure, never the response body.

origin-client.page_size.description: pageSize of a paged Origin read: the spec's maximum for pull request comments and namespaces.
origin-client.page_size.x-source: the official Origin OpenAPI 3.1 spec (pageSize maximum)

origin-client.sha_chars.description: Lengths in hex characters of a full commit SHA (SHA-1, SHA-256); a merge guard needs one of these, never an abbreviation.

origin-client.statuses.description: The kind an HTTP status answers with, as data, so no status is spelled in the module (LT1). A status not listed is 'http'.
origin-client.statuses.x-source: the official Origin OpenAPI 3.1 spec (its error responses), LT1

origin-client.timeout_s.description: Timeout of one Origin API call; a call past it fails as a timeout instead of hanging the lane.

origin-client.user_namespace_type.description: The namespace type GET /namespaces returns for the caller's own account; the only identity the public API attests for a user credential.
